purpose: This template is for Hays consultants to compile and present candidate information in a standardized format, combining structured data fields with professional commentary and qualifications.
summary_guidance: The 'Our expert opinion' section should summarize the candidate's strengths, suitability for the target role, and key differentiators based on their experience and qualifications.
formatting_guidance: Use consistent bullet points for skills and qualifications. Dates should follow the format 'MMM YYYY'. Currency should be in GBP unless otherwise specified. Avoid markdown; use plain text with line breaks.
validation_guidance: Ensure all merge fields are populated, instruction blocks are removed, and contact details are accurate. Confirm that salary and notice period match candidate inputs. Verify that the candidate ID is correct and unique.
pii_guidance: PII fields include candidate_name, candidate_id, candidate_town, expected_salary, employee_email, and employee_tel_no. Handle in compliance with data protection policies. Do not share externally without consent.

instruction_blocks.text: Paste the candidate’s own CV in this space and please delete these instructions before finalising the document.

Alternatively, if you want to create a new CV for the candidate in a fully Hays branded format, then locate the Candidate CV template held here http://haysnet.hays.loc/uk/Pages/Default.aspx. Highlight all of the content in that template and copy it. Then highlight all of this red text and the heading of this page ‘Candidate’s own CV’ and press delete. Then paste the content from the other template
